title: Correct product multiplicities and bound the promised Cartesian-product subclass
statement: For K3,3 square K3, correct signed spectrum is +/-2sqrt2 each multiplicity2, +/-sqrt5 each multiplicity5, +/-sqrt2 each multiplicity2. The producer optional2,6,1 table gives trace96 instead of18*5=90; corrected2,5,2 gives90, while the valid2sqrt2 norm/lift remain intact. For a CONNECTED REGULAR NONBIPARTITE RAMANUJAN product with H bipartite of degree a>=3 and K nonbipartite of degree b>=2, put r=2sqrt(a+b-1). Nontrivial product eigenvalues b+lambda2(H) and -a+lambda_min(K), with lambda2(H)>=0 and lambda_min(K)<=-1, imply b<=r and a+1<=r. Thus(b-2)^2<=4a,(a-1)^2<=4(b-1), giving a<=5,b<=6,total degree<=11. Alon-Boppana in either growing factor eventually violates the product Ramanujan promise, since b+2sqrt(a-1)>r and a+2sqrt(b-1)>r. Hence factor orders and isomorphism types are QUALITATIVELY finite in this regime. No explicit vertex bound was computed. Tensor signing remains valid outside the promise; this is not a general signability negative or a bound on dense/Paley families.
